snippet.title: CoreMine Corp - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover CoreMine Corp on Steam. Release scheduled for Q4 2026 : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4672980/Coremine_Corp/

Welcome to CoreMine Corp. You job here is to set up production chains, manage your electricity, juggle contracts and stock-up while upgrading your factory. Time to prove your worth.
